observations: Photo 0: bare engine, top-down view, 'KIA' logo embossed on black valve cover, intake manifold with orange tool hanging off port, blue injector connectors visible, no visible engine code or ID plate.

Photo 1: same engine, 'KIA' and 'DOHC 16V' lettering stamped on cam cover, exhaust manifold with three pipes, seller's feet in sandals for scale, dirt/oil residue and a red paint/marker spot on the cover.

Photo 2: side/front view showing pulleys, belt, and another 'KIA' badge on the black cover; engine sits on bare concrete floor among other used engines in background, confirming a used-parts yard setting.
No engine code, serial number, or ID sticker is legible in any photo.
No wiring harness, ECU, starter, or alternator shown attached; unclear if these are included.
No video, sound, or compression-test evidence of the engine running.

identity.kind: used petrol engine (likely Kia-fit, exact model/displacement unconfirmed)

claims.evidence: No shipping tag, import sticker, or country-of-origin marking visible in any photo; 'tokumbo' and country of import cannot be confirmed from images alone.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (standard for 'tokumbo' engine sales)
claims.evidence: No start-up video, no compression test, no oil/cylinder inspection shown; engine shown static and dirty in all three photos.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unknown, which affects compatibility and value across different Kia models
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine ID plate/stamped code, usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified used Kia engine, at the low end of any matching range

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal wear (compression, rings, bearings)
risks.proof: Video of engine cranking/running with audible idle, or a compression test reading

risks.risk: Missing ancillary parts (starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, ECU) that buyer may assume are included
risks.proof: Full 360° photos showing all sides of engine with ancillaries attached, or itemized list with photos
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, excluding ancillaries

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, cracks, or damage on the side not photographed
risks.proof: Additional photos of the unseen side/bottom of the block and oil pan

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine ID/serial plate or stamped code on the block
Video of the engine cranking or running
Photos of the engine from the opposite side and underside (oil pan, bellhousing)
Confirmation/photo of included ancillaries (starter, alternator, wiring, sensors)
response.reason: The engine's exact model/code, which materially sets its market value among Kia engine variants, is not legible in any photo, and no running/condition evidence is provided, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without the ID plate or a start-up clip.
